items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think either he, either I subbed for him, or they didn’t list me. I didn’t do the whole album, I did some of it

ctx.x: Oh, it is on there, ‘cause I noticed on the recording itself it says Barry Galbraith, which is true, but Barry was probably, it was contracted to play the guitar. But I think either he, either I subbed for him, or they didn’t list me. I didn’t do the whole album, I
did some of it, but the last album, Lady In Satin, was like being in church. Again, the spiritual content was so deep on that record and I’m glad it was a hit. Yeah, it was a hit.
